item.title: Quantify Your Impact in Interviews 📊 • Use: “I increased team efficiency by 20% using agile methods.” • Highlight specific numbers to show scale and impact. • Prepare examples where you took initiative and led projects. • Discuss challenges you overcame to achieve results. • Share lessons learned and how you applied them. How can you quantify your achievements to showcase ownership effectively? #interview #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
